escalation.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in
escalation.channel: call 1930 · report on cybercrime.gov.in · call your bank to block the account/card
escalation.when_to_use: Immediately — within hours if possible, so the money can be traced and frozen. Note the acknowledgement number and quote it in your police complaint.
escalation.source: Shikayat Saathi verified playbook (checked against the regulators' texts, 2026-10-07)

escalation.name: Station House Officer (SHO), Noida ExpressWay
escalation.channel: written complaint at the police station · e-FIR on your state police citizen portal where available
escalation.when_to_use: Give your written complaint at the police station. For a cognizable offence the police must register an FIR; you can report at any police station (zero FIR) and you are entitled to a free copy. Get a signed and stamped receipt for your written complaint.
escalation.source: Shikayat Saathi verified playbook (checked against the regulators' texts, 2026-10-07)

escalation.name: Superintendent of Police / Deputy Commissioner of Police
escalation.channel: complaint in writing by registered post or in person
escalation.when_to_use: If the SHO refuses to register an FIR: send the substance of your complaint in writing to the SP/DCP (BNSS, 2023, s.173(4)). Keep the postal receipt.
escalation.source: Shikayat Saathi verified playbook (checked against the regulators' texts, 2026-10-07)

escalation.name: Judicial Magistrate
escalation.channel: application through a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority (free if eligible)
escalation.when_to_use: If the police still do not act: apply to the Magistrate to direct registration and investigation (BNSS, 2023, s.175(3)).
escalation.source: Shikayat Saathi verified playbook (checked against the regulators' texts, 2026-10-07)
